items.text: Task 1.1: tests/bench_gossip_perf.rs — iroh-gossip vs libp2p-gossipsub publish→receive latency on BlobInventoryDelta payloads. 100ms heartbeat tuning for libp2p side; explicit Subscribed wait before measured publishes. (569 lines, uncommitted)
